messages:
Elaine: Heads-up — webinar landing page goes live next Tue. Need a quick plan for paid: search + retargeting + creative refresh. Primary goal: signups, secondary: demo requests. Budget avail: $12k for first 2 weeks. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Omar: For search I suggest 60/40 branded vs non-branded to start. Push fast-moving bids for branded at launch hour. Non-branded pacing: start 30% day 1, ramp to 60% by day 7.

Lucy: Agree on split. For retargeting we should do a 7-day and 30-day window with different creatives — 7-day gets urgency creative, 30-day gets educational. Also reuse last quarter's testimonial carousel.

Ben: Creative ask for Design: can we get 3 hero variations by EOD Friday? One focused on speed/latency, one on reliability, one on cost-savings. Keep CTAs: Register / Book Demo.

Design: Will produce 3 concepts. Send any preferred headlines or metrics to include.

Elaine: Key headlines: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" and "Cut per-token inference cost by up to 3x". Use the webinar date: May 12.

Omar: Quick pacing suggestion (rough):
```
week1: 70% search (of spend), 20% retargeting, 10% experiments
week2: 50% search, 35% retargeting, 15% creative refresh/paid social tests
```
Increase non-branded bids after first 48h if CPA < target.

Kat: Landing page form has 2-step capture. If someone signs up but doesn't confirm, we run a 3-email sequence. Can we add a campaign parameter so we can map paid channel to the CR funnel? Use utm_campaign=webinar_may12_paid.

MKT-bot: Reminder: marketing-playbook/docs/webinar-pacing has last quarter benchmarks. Link: https://go.redwood/webinar-pacing :memo:

Lucy: For ad copy refresh, small test matrix: headline A/B, CTA text A/B, image static vs short gif. Keep one control creative from last quarter to measure lift.

Ben: I'll set up the GA+GAds labels today and seed the campaign. Omar — can you share recommended max CPCs for non-branded?

Omar: Sharing ballpark non-branded CPCs in channel: US SaaS keywords $3.50-$7, enterprise intent $8-$15 depending on match. Start at low end and monitor impression share.

Elaine: Action items: 1) Design deliver 3 hero creatives (Design) 2) Ben sets up campaigns + UTM (Ben) 3) Omar handles bidding/pacing strategy and live adjustments (Omar) 4) Lucy manages retargeting segments and creative tests (Lucy) 5) Kat confirms form + email sequence (Kat). We'll sync Mon 9am for first 48h readout. :rocket:

Design: noted.

Ben: Done — campaign skeleton created, sharing draft link: https://ads.google.com/redirect (will DM access).

Omar: I'll watch pacing and post a short update after 24h and 72h.

Elaine: Thanks team — we want to be conservative on spend first day and let creative signal. If CPAs look good, we scale to hit the $12k window.

MKT-bot: @channel Weekly budget check reminder scheduled for Mon 08:00.
